title: Share conversation
description: Publish a read-only snapshot of the current branch, including text, images and research reports. Anyone with the link can read it.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
expired: This share has expired. Create a new link to share again.
deleteNotice: New messages are shared only when you update this snapshot. Deleting this conversation also cancels its share.
publishFailed: Could not publish the snapshot. Please try again.
revokeFailed: Could not cancel sharing. The conversation and link have been kept. Please try again.
tooLarge: This snapshot exceeds the sharing limits. Reduce its text or images and try again.
imageFailed: An image could not be prepared. Check that the images are available and use a supported format.
conflict: This share changed in another tab. Close and reopen this dialog before updating.
imageUnavailable: This image is unavailable. The share may have changed; refresh to try again.
unavailable: This share is no longer available
unavailableDescription: The link may have expired or sharing has been cancelled.
retryDescription: Check your connection and try again.
